name: Dealer CRM-portal
title_zh: 34 条日记翻到底的汽车经销商 CRM 自动操作员
tagline_zh: 登录、翻白板、拉历史、打分、写备注、移日记一气呵成。每天省下 40 分钟手工点击。
tagline_en: Login, extract whiteboard, pull ERA history, score leads, log notes, move diary entries—all hands-off. Saves ~40.
desc_en: Automate actions on the Dealer Management Portal / CRM automotive dealer portal, including authenticated logins, whiteboard extracts, full 34+ entry diary pagination, ERA customer modal history extraction, lead likelihood scoring, and autonomous prospect note logging + diary moving.
why_zh: 不是简单录屏回放，而是按页面状态驱动决策：白板提取、分页翻全、弹窗历史、线索打分、备注落库。
why_en: State-driven, not scripted: it verifies each action's result before proceeding, so pagination, modal extraction, and note.
limit_zh: 只认 Dealer Management Portal / CRM 汽车经销商门户这一套页面结构。
limit_en: Only works on this specific Dealer Management Portal layout; breaks on redesigns. Needs existing credentials, no captcha handling. Output stops at.
title_en: Dealer CRM portal operator that flips all 34 diary entries
